title: 308. Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array II

examples.explanation: The array is already sorted, so the first element is minimal.
Rotation moved the minimum 0 into the middle.

hints: Compare the middle element with the right end to decide which half holds the minimum.
When they are equal, shrink the right end by one since duplicates give no information.
Otherwise the classic rotated-array binary search choice applies.
